none: PAS NLM-B29798: Roman Coin: Radiate indeterminate from Winteringham
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate indeterminate, issue of 260-275, Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust, possibly cuirassed, right. Reverse description: Figure, possibly SALVS, standing left, holding out arm left to feed snake, another object slanting to the right. Reverse inscription: [SA]LVS [AVG]. Diameter: 17.7mm, Weight: 1.82gms, die axis: 12
